description: USE THIS to check whether a date is a public/bank holiday when computing business-day deadlines, delivery SLAs or 'next working day'. Supports ~200 countries (ISO code, e.g. GB, US, ZA, DE, IN); GB defaults to England — pass a subdivision ('SCT'/'WLS'/'NIR', or a US state) to narrow.

country.description: ISO country code (default GB), e.g. GB, US, ZA, DE.

subdiv.description: Subdivision code (e.g. UK nation SCT/WLS/NIR, or a US state).

name: is_holiday
